claim: Fail-closed at gateways: hardware affinity failures, missing PERPETUATOOLSROOT + explicit provider, unresolvable model IDs produce explicit errors — never silent fallback, never fail-open. Discovery tools (discover.py, network watcher) are exempt and must degrade gracefully.
